solution:
**Given:-** A table conataining information of sales of cars in particular year

**To find:-** The year in which percentage of type A cars sold out of the total number of cars sold is maximum

**Concept used:-** % change = (part of quantity )/(Total quantity) times 100

**Calculation:-**

We have to find the year in which the value of (Car A)/(Total cars)times 100 is maximum,

⇒ Lets find out the sales of total cars in particular year,

⇒ In year 2007:- Total sales = 15 + 12 + 10 + 8 + 9 = 54

⇒ In year 2008:- Total sales = 10 + 10 + 13 + 12 + 12 = 57

⇒ In year 2009:- Total sales = 25 + 10 + 12 + 19 + 18 = 84

⇒ In year 2010:- Total sales = 12 + 18 + 13 + 12 + 12 = 67

⇒ In year 2011:- Total sales = 19 + 12 + 12 +14 + 14 = 71

⇒ In year 2012:- Total sales = 15 + 14 + 14 + 14 + 15 = 72

 

% Car A against total sales in different years -

⇒ In year 2007:- % sales of Car A = (15)/(54)times 100 = 27% (approx)

⇒ In year 2008:- % sales of Car A = (10)/(57)times 100 = 18% (approx)

⇒ **In year 2009:- % sales of Car A = ****(25)/(84)times 100 =29 % (approx)**

⇒ In year 2010:- % sales of Car A = (12)/(67)times 100 = 18% (approx)

⇒ In year 2011:- % sales of Car A = (19)/(71)times 100 = 26% (approx)

⇒ In year 2012:- % sales of Car A = (15)/(72)times 100 = 20% (approx)

 

**.·.We can observe that in year 2009, there is maximum percentage of sales of Car A against total sale of car.**
